text.p: Freeport McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc and Freeport McMoRan Inc said a class action lawsuit alleging environmental and human rights abuses by the two companies at their Indonesian operations was dismissed Friday by a Louisiana court.

Yosefa Alomang, an Indonesian citizen, had made the allegations, but Judge Michael Bagneris of the Louisiana State Court ruled Friday that the court had no jurisdiction to hear the case, Louisiana-based Freeport said in a statement.

"The allegations made in the Alomang case had been previously reviewed and rejected by a series of independent examinations of the environmental, human rights and social/cultural impact of FCX's operations in Indonesia," the statement added.
Freeport said it was also confident that a similar lawsuit filed by Tom Beanal, another Indonesian citizen, at the federal court level will also be dismissed.
The federal lawsuit has been filed at the United States Court in the Eastern District of Louisiana.
